snapshot.h2: How we work with restaurants in Fort Lauderdale and Broward

facts.label: Services
facts.value: Social media, websites, SEO and AEO, ads

paragraphsHtml: We come to your restaurant in Fort Lauderdale to film, and one shoot typically produces 4 to 6 weeks of content. Our Miami team then posts it, manages your pages and keeps your Google Business Profile current.

Shimuja Ramen, a client of ours for about four years by Chef Kei's count, started in Southwest Ranches in Broward. It now serves at Julia & Henry's in Downtown Miami, and we make short videos for it that keep the ramen front and center, with one goal: getting people from the feed to a seat at the counter.

proof.h2: Shimuja Ramen, a client that started in Broward
proof.bodyHtml: Shimuja started in Southwest Ranches, in Broward, before moving to Julia & Henry's in Downtown Miami. Its owner, Chef Kei, says a lot of the customers who come to try his ramen find it through the social media we run for him.

steps.h2: How we'd start with your Fort Lauderdale restaurant

items.title: Talk with Juan for 30 minutes
items.bodyHtml: The first call is free, and it's with Juan, our co-founder. He looks at your Google Business Profile, your website and your social pages and tells you what he'd focus on first.

items.title: Schedule a shoot at your restaurant
items.bodyHtml: Our crew comes to you and films on a day that suits your schedule. We then edit the footage into social media content for your pages.

items.title: Posting, Google and reporting
items.bodyHtml: We post and manage your pages, keep your Google profile accurate through our restaurant SEO and AEO work, and send a monthly report. Ads can be added whenever you're ready.

pricingHtml: Most restaurants invest $1,500 to $5,000 a month for a coordinated program. Website builds are a one-time $1,500 or $2,000.

faqs.q: Do you work with restaurants in Fort Lauderdale and Broward?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with restaurants in Fort Lauderdale and across Broward County, and our crew films at your restaurant. We're headquartered in Miami, FL.

faqs.q: Will your crew come to Fort Lauderdale to film?
faqs.a: Yes. We film at your restaurant in person. One shoot typically produces 4 to 6 weeks of content, which we then post and manage for you.

faqs.q: Do you create content in Spanish?
faqs.a: Yes. We work in English and Spanish, so captions and posts can run in either language or both. Every website page we build comes in both languages.

faqs.q: Do you require a long-term contract?
faqs.a: No. We don't require long-term contracts. You can start with one service and add more later.

cta.h2: Let's talk about your Fort Lauderdale restaurant
cta.body: Book a free 30-minute call with Juan, our co-founder. He'll go over how your restaurant shows up online and tell you what he would do first, in English or Spanish.
